subject: Trial monitoring readiness & on-call roster — next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novafin.com>, Drew Mills <drew.mills@novafin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial monitoring readiness & on-call roster — next steps

Hi Claire / Drew —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the 30-day trial aligned to Novafin's success criteria. I captured the items we discussed on the call and added owners below. Please flag anything missing.

Summary of agreed goals for the trial (provisional):
- End-to-end latency under 200ms median for single-request inference (peak tests up to our planned load).
- 99.5% success rate (no server errors) over a 24-hour soak.
- Traceable request flow into Novafin's SSO-authenticated app: request_id propagated through logs and tracing.
- Cost-per-1000-requests estimate for your dev workload (we'll provide a config + estimate).

Observability scope we recommend for trial acceptance:
1) Dashboards: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), token throughput, error rate, tail latency heatmap, and cost burn rate.
2) Tracing: distributed traces with span for request ingress -> model inference -> response, sample rate 1:100 initially.
3) Logs: structured request logs with request_id, user_id (masked), model_version, and kv-cache hit/miss. Export to your GCS/S3 bucket daily.
4) Metrics export: Prometheus-style metrics pushed to your collector or via our telemetry export.

Proposed owners & next steps: 
- Redwood: Marcus (trial lead) — deliver dashboard wireframe, baseline metrics export, initial tracing config, and a readiness runbook.
- Redwood: Monica (solutions/observability) — build Grafana dashboard prototype and share screenshots.
- Novafin: Claire (engineering lead) — validate success criteria, provide a test dataset and SSO/auth details.
- Novafin: Drew (platform) — allocate a small dev namespace and storage for logs, confirm retention policy.

Milestone timeline (draft):
- Day 0 (kickoff): share checklist + access matrix (today).
- Day 3: wireframe dashboard + tracing config shared.
- Day 7: smoke test with 10k synthetic requests, iterate alerts.
- Day 14: 24-hour soak, validation against acceptance criteria.
- Day 21-30: optimization and handoff.

Attachments: novafin-eval-checklist.xlsx (baseline acceptance checklist), dashboard-wireframe-v1.png (initial mock).

Can you confirm owners and whether the timeline looks reasonable? If so, I will set up the internal on-call roster for the trial window and schedule the kickoff for Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0109

From: Claire Park <claire.park@novafin.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Drew Mills <drew.mills@novafin.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial monitoring readiness & on-call roster — next steps

Thanks Marcus — this looks great and matches our expectations. A few clarifications and one ask from our side: 

Clarifications:
- Latency target: 200ms median is acceptable; can we include a 95th percentile target of <350ms? That reflects our UX bar.
- Tracing: we'll want all traces to include a request_id and a user_type flag (anonymized).

Ask: we need an automated export of error-level logs to our S3 bucket within 15 minutes of occurrence (for our incident correlation). Is that doable during the trial?

Stakeholders: I'll be the trial owner internally and will loop in our security SME (Manu Patel) if we need to share more info about the SOC2 artifacts. Drew will handle the infra pieces.

Timeline: Day 3 wireframe is fine — could we move the Day 7 smoke test to Day 5? We want to surface issues earlier.

I attached the completed SOC2 questionnaire you asked for and a short CSV with the test user groups.

Claire Park
VP, Engineering — Novafin
claire.park@novafin.com

Attachments: soc2-questionnaire-completed.pdf, novafin-test-users.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novafin.com>, Drew Mills <drew.mills@novafin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial monitoring readiness & on-call roster — next steps

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. Affirmative on all points, and we can accelerate the smoke test to Day 5. Short answers and actions below: 

- 95th percentile target: will add p95 < 350ms to the acceptance checklist.
- Error log export: yes — we can configure a near-real-time push of error logs (severity >= ERROR) to your S3 with ~5–10 minute latency. Monica will coordinate the S3 destination and credentials.
- Tracing: request_id + user_type flag will be included; we'll mask any PII.

Updated timeline (confirmed):
- Day 0: access matrix + kickoff (this Friday)
- Day 3: dashboard wireframe + tracing config (Monica)
- Day 5: smoke test 10k synthetic requests (redwood + novafin)
- Day 14: 24-hour soak and acceptance check

Owners (confirmed):
- Marcus Lin (Redwood) — overall trial lead, primary contact.
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — observability engineering (Grafana, tracing, logs).
- Laura Bennett (Redwood) — customer success and runbook/alerts.
- Claire Park (Novafin) — product/acceptance owner.
- Drew Mills (Novafin) — infra contact.

Next operational step: Monica will send a dashboard prototype (Grafana screenshots) and an on-call rota proposal by tomorrow EOD. Laura will draft alert definitions and the runbook for the Day 5 smoke test. I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Friday at 10:00am PT if that works for Novafin.

Attachments added to this thread: novafin-eval-checklist.xlsx (updated), dashboard-wireframe-v1.png (prototype).

Marcus

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Trial monitoring readiness & on-call roster — internal ops plan

Forwarding the finalized external thread for visibility. Internal ops notes below (actions for the team):

Internal action items (owners & times):
- Monica: Build Grafana dashboard prototype -> export PNGs and share link. (Due: 2026-09-15 18:00 PT) (attached: dashboard-wireframe-v1.png)
- Sergio: Implement tracing config in staging cluster, set sample rate and add request_id propagation in the gateway. (Due: 2026-09-16 12:00 PT)
- Laura: Draft runbook and PagerDuty rota for the trial window (include severity thresholds and SLOs). (Due: 2026-09-16 17:00 PT)
- Marcus: Coordinate kickoff invite and confirm Novafin infra access. (Due: 2026-09-15 12:00 PT)

Alert definitions to include in runbook (draft):
- High error rate: > 1% errors sustained for 2 minutes -> page P1.
- Latency spike: p95 increases by >50% vs baseline -> page on-call.
- KV-cache degradation: cache hit rate < 60% for 5 minutes -> pager.

Notes on exports and retention:
- Error logs will stream to novafin-error-exports bucket with 14-day retention by default (we can extend if requested).
- Prometheus metrics endpoint will be available at /metrics on the trial ingress; we will add a scrapper config for Novafin's collector.

Attachments referenced: dashboard-wireframe-v1.png, novafin-eval-checklist.xlsx

Monica Patel

Redwood Inference
